name: quality-results
purpose: One place to read every dbt test result the platform records: each product's builder writes its own tests' results beside its outputs, and this product unions them, one row per test per dbt invocation, with the product it belongs to.
limitations: As current as its last build, hourly at minute 50, so a product's build since then is not in it yet. A product that has never built with a test has no results table and no rows here. Only tests that ran are recorded: a build Airflow never started leaves no row. The bronze audit's checks (lake.<fence>.audit_checks) are not in it yet.
usage: The newest status of each test of a product: the rows of its product_id with the greatest run_started_at per unique_id. run_id joins a row to the product's run records (governance.run_records.run_record).

outputs.purpose: One row per dbt data test and unit test a product's builder ran, from the results table that builder writes beside its outputs (dbt/macros/k2_results.sql), with the product it belongs to.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: The product whose builder ran the test, <domain>.<product>.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The Airflow run, <dag_id>/<run_id>; joins the product's run records.

columns.name: release_id
columns.description: The release the run resolved at its start, <tag>-<sha12>.

columns.name: run_started_at
columns.description: When the dbt invocation started, UTC.

columns.name: writer
columns.description: The builder that ran the test, dbt_<fence>; always the product's own.

columns.name: tested
columns.description: The relation of the model or seed tested, <catalog>.<namespace>.<table>; null when dbt did not say.

columns.name: status
columns.description: dbt's status, pass, fail, warn, error or skipped (a test behind a failure in the same invocation).

columns.name: failures
columns.description: The failing rows dbt counted; null when it counted none.

columns.name: message
columns.description: dbt's message, at most 1000 characters; a failed unit test's is the diff.
